data.long_meaning: Editha is derived from the Old English name Ēadgyð, meaning 'wealth' or 'riches' + 'war'. This name was popular among Anglo-Saxon warriors. It was also associated with the goddess Eadgyth, who symbolized wealth and protection. The name Editha carries the meaning “Wealth in battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Editha usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
